think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it has any sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/infinite), breaking the natural numeric ordering. 3) If such sentinel values exist and change behavior beyond simple scaling, classify as a special knob and list those values; otherwise classify as not special.
